Home Embraer C-390 Millennium Greece orders three Embraer KC-390s with options for three more

Greece has signed a contract for three Embraer KC-390 Millennium multi-mission aircraft, with options for another three, under a government-to-government agreement with Portugal. According to Embraer’s announcement on 2 November 2026, the Hellenic Air Force is scheduled to receive its first aircraft in 2027.

The acquisition will strengthen Greece’s airlift and air-to-air refuelling capabilities, while supporting interoperability with NATO allies. The agreement also provides opportunities for cooperation with European operators in training, maintenance support and logistics.
Greece becomes the seventh European country to select the Millennium, joining Portugal, Hungary, the Netherlands, Austria, the Czech Republic and Sweden.

The KC-390 can carry up to 26 tonnes and fly at 470 knots. Its missions include troop and cargo transport, airdrops, medical evacuation, search and rescue, firefighting and humanitarian operations. It can operate from unpaved runways and, with refuelling equipment installed, serve as both a tanker and a receiver.

title_en: FAA orders Boeing 787 fuel tank inspections over lightning strike explosion risk
title_zh: FAA 因雷击爆炸风险下令波音 787 油箱检查
summary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has ordered inspections of certain Boeing 787 Dreamliners after discovering that required manufacturing… The post FAA orders Boeing 787 fuel tank inspections over lightning strike explosion risk appeared first on AeroT
summary_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 在发现需要制造后，已下令对某些波音 787 梦想飞机进行检查……
body_en: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has ordered inspections of certain Boeing 787 Dreamliners after discovering that required manufacturing checks of fuel tank sealant were not completed or could not be verified, raising concerns about a potential fuel tank explosion during a lightning strike.

The FAA airworthiness directive (AD), published November 2, 2026, applies to certain Boeing 787-8, 787-9 and 787-10 aircraft. The FAA estimates that 60 US-registered aircraft are affected. The directive takes effect December 7, 2026.
The problem involves sealant installations inside the center wing fuel tank that lacked evidence of required visual and adhesion inspections during production.
The FAA warned that defective sealant could allow an ignition source to develop inside the tank during a lightning strike, potentially igniting fuel vapors.

“The unsafe condition, if not addressed, could result in development of an ignition source within the fuel tank volume and a risk of a fuel tank explosion during a lightning strike event,” the FAA said.

Under the directive, operators must carry out detailed inspections of sealant installations in the left, right and center wing side-of-body areas, including sections between the side-of-body rib and rib 2. The work includes checking for sealant defects, surface depressions and inadequate adhesion.
Any defects identified during the inspections must be addressed through approved repairs. The required work follows instructions contained in a Boeing requirements bulletin issued November 5, 2025.

The FAA estimates the AD inspections and adhesion tests will require approximately 34 hours of work per aircraft, costing $2,890 each. The total estimated cost for the 60 affected US aircraft is $173,400, excluding any repairs.
The agency said it lacked sufficient information to estimate the cost of corrective work that might be necessary if defects are discovered. Some expenses could be covered under Boeing’s warranty.
The directive follows an FAA proposal published February 24, 2026. During the public comment period, Boeing and American Airlines requested changes to the repair requirements.
Boeing asked the FAA to allow repairs using existing approved procedures, rather than requiring separate approval for each repair. The FAA agreed.

American Airlines asked the FAA to clarify where the sealant needed to be tested and whether existing Boeing repair procedures could be used. The FAA clarified the inspection areas and agreed to allow the existing repair procedures.
The Foundation for Aviation Safety separately asked whether Boeing was now performing the required sealant inspections during production.

The FAA said the directive covers aircraft for which there was insufficient evidence that the inspections had been completed. It confirmed that the required inspections are being performed during production on aircraft outside the directive’s scope.

body_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 在发现所需的油箱密封剂制造检查未完成或无法验证后，已下令对某些波音 787 梦想飞机进行检查，引发了人们对雷击期间可能发生油箱爆炸的担忧。
2026 年 11 月 2 日发布的 FAA 适航指令 (AD) 适用于某些波音 787-8、787-9 和 787-10 飞机。 FAA 估计有 60 架在美国注册的飞机受到影响。该指令于 2026 年 12 月 7 日生效。
该问题涉及中心翼油箱内的密封剂安装，缺乏生产过程中所需的目视和附着力检查的证据。
美国联邦航空局警告说，有缺陷的密封剂可能会在雷击期间在油箱内产生火源，从而可能点燃燃油蒸气。
美国联邦航空局表示：“如果不解决这种不安全情况，可能会导致油箱内产生点火源，并在雷击事件中存在油箱爆炸的风险。”
根据该指令，运营商必须对左、右和中翼机身侧面区域的密封剂安装进行详细检查，包括机身侧面肋和肋2之间的部分。工作包括检查密封剂缺陷、表面凹陷和粘合不足。
检查期间发现的任何缺陷必须通过批准的维修来解决。所需工作遵循 2025 年 11 月 5 日发布的波音要求公告中包含的说明。
FAA 估计每架飞机的 AD 检查和附着力测试将需要大约 34 小时的工作时间，每架成本为 2,890 美元。 60 架受影响的美国飞机的总成本预计为 173,400 美元（不包括任何维修费用）。
该机构表示，缺乏足够的信息来估计如果发现缺陷可能需要的纠正工作的成本。一些费用可以由波音公司的保修范围覆盖。
该指令遵循 FAA 于 2026 年 2 月 24 日发布的提案。在公众意见征询期间，波音和美国航空要求更改维修要求。
波音公司要求美国联邦航空局允许使用现有批准的程序进行维修，而不是要求每次维修都单独批准。美国联邦航空局同意了。
美国航空要求美国联邦航空管理局澄清密封剂需要在哪里进行测试，以及是否可以使用现有的波音维修程序。美国联邦航空局明确了检查区域，并同意允许现有的维修程序。
航空安全基金会单独询问波音公司现在是否在生产过程中执行所需的密封剂检查。
美国联邦航空局表示，该指令适用于没有足够证据证明检查已完成的飞机。它确认，在该指令范围之外的飞机生产过程中正在执行所需的检查。
因雷击爆炸风险，美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 下令对波音 787 油箱进行检查

United Airlines is the second-largest international operator from the US, behind American Airlines. Of course, United's strength is long-haul, for which it is comfortably number one. In fact, the Star Alliance member is the world's second-largest long-haul carrier, after Emirates.

On Sunday, October 25, United (like other Northern Hemisphere airlines) switched to winter schedules based on IATA slot seasons. This will be maintained until Saturday, March 27, 2027. In this period, Cirium Diio data shows that United will have an average of 350 daily international departures, up by 2% compared to last winter . 11 additional routes help.
United's 11 International Routes Beginning This Winter

Schedule analysis shows that United will introduce, or resume, the following routes beyond the US border during the cold season. They are from five hubs. As they have all been announced, this article simply summarizes them and provides some context and information.

The October 31 launch of United's first service from Newark to St. Croix is not included. That is because the Caribbean destination is in the US Virgin Islands and is, therefore, considered domestic. United's three flights from Las Vegas to Tokyo Narita in January 2027 for the Consumer Electronics Show are also not featured.

United Now Has 25 Routes From Houston To Mexico

When all airlines and US airports are considered, Cirium shows that United is the second-largest operator from the US to Mexico, behind American. United serves the transborder country from eight hubs and other airports. On a typical day, it has 86 daily departures to Mexico. For very obvious reasons, most of them — 46 daily and 53% of the total — are from Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH).

After a 13-year absence, flights from IAH to Tuxtla Gutiérrez have resumed. As such, United now serves 25 destinations in Mexico from the Texas hub. They include Tulum, to which various US airlines have stopped flying. United will join them, as it is pulling out in January 2027. Service to Chihuahua returns at the start of the summer 2027 season.

Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

Breeze Airways continues to develop its niche network of point-to-point flights between secondary airports or unserved markets. The airline will add services to six new destinations in the coming months, with the airline replacing Spirit on a number of routes, while also adding new international destinations in Jamaica and the Dominican Republic .

Utah-based Breeze Airways is another airline developed by aviation entrepreneur David Neeleman , who also supported the establishment of Azul Linhas Aereas , JetBlue, and WestJet . Breeze operates a fleet of 66 Airbus A220-300 aircraft.
Breeze Airways Swoops In On Routes Left By Spirit

As US ultra-low-cost carrier Spirit Airlines collapsed earlier this year , a number of popular leisure routes were left unserved. While some airlines, like JetBlue, were able to establish an extensive network in Fort Lauderdale after Spirit's exit , other carriers have been slowly picking up the pieces left behind by the Florida-based budget airline.

A major gap was left at Myrtle Beach International Airport (MYR). Breeze has been one airline stepping up here, and is now one of the largest carriers at the airport by destinations served. This coming February, Breeze will reconnect the South Carolina tourist hotspot of Myrtle Beach and Latrobe (LBE) and Boston Logan International Airport (BOS) with regular nonstop flights.

Adding to the airline's network will be a nonstop flight from Latrobe to Orlando International Airport (MCO). The airline's reintroduction of flights to Latrobe reestablishes commercial air service at the Pennsylvania airport that otherwise was left abandoned by Spirit.
International Flights To The Dominican Republic & Jamaica

Montego Bay (MBJ) and Santo Domingo (SDQ) will become the airline's latest international destinations when the airline adds services to these popular vacation hotspots. Breeze will add the nonstop flight from Tampa to Montego Bay in December, followed by Santo Domingo the following June.

These routes from Tampa join the airline's growing international network from the airport, which will see Cancun International Airport (CUN) also join the list this December 18 (not counted in this analysis). A full breakdown of Breeze's international services from Tampa can be seen in the table below.

A notable mention is Breeze's upcoming new service that will connect Tampa to St. Thomas (STT) in the US Virgin Islands. This is not classed as an international flight. Travelers between these two cities can travel without a passport. Breeze will add the new flights to St. Thomas on December 16.
Three New Breeze Airways Routes Will Serve Buffalo

Buffalo Niagara International Airport (BUF) is set to gain three new Breeze Airways routes next June/July, as the airline connects the upstate New York city to Charleston (CHS), Myrtle Beach and Raleigh–Durham International Airport (RDU). All services will begin in time for the peak of summer.
Of these new services from Buffalo, just one will face direct competition. Denver-based Frontier Airlines maintains a seasonal service from Buffalo to Raleigh.

title_en: WestJet Vs. Porter Airlines: Which Carrier Is More Premium In 2026?
title_zh: 西捷航空 vs.波特航空：2026 年哪家航空公司更优质？
summary: The Canadian airline market is highly competitive in 2026, with Porter Airlines and WestJet offering some of the best premium products.

body_en: WestJet Vs. Porter Airlines: Which Carrier Is More Premium In 2026?
Airline and Airport Management Graduate, Student Commercial Pilot and Commercial Aviation Writer.

Canadian air travel has long been defined by a strict dual-class hierarchy, with flag carriers drawing a hard line between elite business class amenities and standard main cabin seating. However, as Porter Airlines aggressively expands its fleet of Embraer E195-E2 jets from coast to coast, the definition of a premium domestic flight has undergone a dramatic transformation. WestJet counters by refining its Boeing 787-9 business class and rolling out high-speed Starlink WiFi across its narrowbody fleet, so now, Canadian travelers face two fundamentally different visions of luxury.

Deciding which airline holds the true premium crown depends entirely on whether a passenger values front-of-cabin hard product hardware or an upgraded baseline economy experience. As both carriers vie for market share across transcontinental and transborder routes, comparing their cabin products, seat pitches, and inflight services is more important than ever before booking.

WestJet offers the superior high-end premium product, while Porter Airlines delivers a far more upscale everyday experience for the average passenger. WestJet’s top-tier product is its business class cabin on the 787-9, which features fully lie-flat seats, direct aisle access, premium dining, and dedicated lounge access on long-haul routes. Conversely, Porter does not fly widebody aircraft or offer lie-flat seats, instead focusing on what it markets as an elevated economy experience across its entire fleet.

The fundamental difference lies in how each airline treats the main cabin. As per Seat Maps , Porter’s E195-E2 jets feature a two-by-two seating configuration with no middle seats, complimentary beer and wine served in real glassware, premium Canadian snacks, and fast, free WiFi for every passenger. WestJet’s narrowbody Boeing 737 fleet sticks to a traditional three-by-three layout in economy, where middle seats remain standard and buy-on-board food and drink policies apply.

Ultimately, WestJet wins for long-haul luxury and dedicated premium seating upfront, whereas Porter wins for overall comfort and inflight amenities in the main cabin. For anyone seeking true intercontinental luxury, complete with fully lie-flat suites, direct aisle access, multi-course dining, and dedicated airport lounge access, WestJet’s 787-9 fleet provides a full-service hard product that Porter cannot match. However, for standard domestic economy travel, Porter completely reshapes expectations by removing the dreaded middle seat across its entire E195-E2 fleet.

On narrowbody routes, WestJet’s premium product is WestJet Premium , situated in the forward rows of its 737s. This dedicated cabin features much wider recliner seats in a two-by-two layout, 37 inches to 38 inches (94 centimeters to 97 centimeters) of seat pitch, hot meal choices, and complimentary alcoholic drinks served on multi-hour flights.

Porter takes a different hardware approach with its top fare, PorterReserve . Rather than installing wider business-class seats, PorterReserve utilizes the same two-by-two seat frame found throughout the E195-E2 cabin, but expands seat pitch substantially to 36 inches (91 centimeters) across the first four rows. Instead of a wider chair, PorterReserve is a fully bundled, all-inclusive fare tier that includes fresh meals, pre-mixed cocktails, dedicated airport check-in, priority security screening, early boarding, two free checked bags, and fee-free flight changes.

On shorter domestic hops, PorterReserve frequently delivers comparable legroom and superior soft-product perks at a fraction of the cost of traditional business class. However, on transcontinental flights exceeding four hours, flyers seeking a true widebody recliner or lie-flat bed will find WestJet’s hardware significantly more comfortable.

Aviation analysts and industry reviewers frequently frame PorterReserve not as a traditional business class, but as an enhanced, all-inclusive economy product. A September 2026 review by Frugal Flyer noted that even though PorterReserve falls short of international long-haul business class standards, citing cold meals served in cardboard packaging and standard seat padding, its price-to-value ratio directly challenges Air Canada ’s domestic business class and WestJet Premium. The reviewer concluded that Porter is best understood as an upgraded, hassle-free way to fly economy without surprise add-on fees.

Porter’s strategy of democratizing cabin comfort has earned substantial industry accolades. Passengers voted Porter an APEX Four Star Major Airline , while the carrier also earned USA Today’s Readers’ Choice award for Best Economy Class and was named Skytrax’s Best Regional Airline in North America.

Meanwhile, WestJet continues to defend its premium positioning by expanding its long-haul Dreamliner network across Europe and Asia, operating non-stop routes as long as Calgary International Airport (YYC) to Rome Fiumicino Airport (FCO). WestJet executives emphasize that their two-tier strategy, combining international widebody luxury with a high-density regional fleet, provides the full-service flexibility that global business travelers demand, as reported by AvioRadar .

When compared with Canada's flag carrier, Air Canada, both WestJet and Porter fill distinct operational niches in the domestic and transborder markets. Air Canada’s Signature Class on Boeing 787, 777, and Airbus A330 aircraft remains the traditional benchmark for long-haul business class in North America, featuring private executive pods and extensive Maple Leaf Lounge networks. However, on domestic and transborder narrowbody routes, Air Canada’s standard economy cabin features the same three-by-three seating grid and buy-on-board food service found across WestJet’s 737 fleet.

Against low-cost alternatives like Flair Airlines , Porter and WestJet sit in a completely different tier of reliability and service. Ultra-low-cost carriers strip away all passenger amenities to offer bare-bones transport, whereas Porter elevates the baseline flight experience without charging flag-carrier premium prices. Meanwhile, WestJet approaches its own soft product differentiation by offering a spectrum of products ranging from ultra-basic economy up to widebody transcontinental business suites.
body_zh: 西捷航空 vs.波特航空：2026 年哪家航空公司更优质？
航空公司和机场管理毕业生、商业飞行员学生和商业航空作家。

加拿大航空旅行长期以来一直以严格的双舱等级制度来定义，旗舰航空公司在精英商务舱设施和标准主舱座位之间划定了严格的界限。然而，随着波特航空公司从一个海岸到另一个海岸积极扩大其巴西航空工业公司 E195-E2 喷气机机队，优质国内航班的定义已经发生了巨大的转变。西捷航空对此进行了反击，改进了其波音 787-9 商务舱，并在其窄体机队中推出了高速 Starlink WiFi，因此现在加拿大旅客面临着两种截然不同的奢华愿景。
决定哪家航空公司拥有真正的高端皇冠完全取决于乘客是否看重客舱前部硬产品硬件或升级后的基准经济体验。由于两家航空公司都在跨大陆和跨境航线上争夺市场份额，因此在预订之前比较其客舱产品、座椅间距和机上服务比以往任何时候都更加重要。
西捷航空提供卓越的高端优质产品，而波特航空则为普通乘客提供更高档的日常体验。西捷航空的顶级产品是 787-9 上的商务舱，配备完全平躺式座椅、直接通道、高级餐饮以及长途航线上的专用休息室。相反，波特航空不驾驶宽体飞机，也不提供平躺式座椅，而是专注于其整个机队的提升经济体验。
根本的区别在于各家航空公司对待主舱的方式不同。根据座位图，波特的 E195-E2 喷气式飞机采用两乘二的座位配置，没有中间座位，为每位乘客提供装在真正的玻璃器皿中的免费啤酒和葡萄酒、优质加拿大小吃以及快速、免费的 WiFi。西捷航空的窄体波音 737 机队在经济舱中坚持传统的三乘三布局，中间座位仍然是标准配置，并适用机上食品和饮料政策。
最终，西捷航空凭借长途豪华和专用的高级座位而获胜，而波特则凭借主舱的整体舒适度和机上设施而获胜。对于那些寻求真正的洲际奢华体验的人来说，西捷航空的 787-9 机队提供了波特无法比拟的全方位服务硬产品，包括完全平躺的套房、直接通道、多道菜餐饮和专用机场休息室。然而，对于标准的国内经济舱旅行，波特通过取消其整个 E195-E2 机队中可怕的中间座位，彻底重塑了预期。
在窄体客机航线上，西捷航空的高端产品是西捷航空豪华客舱，位于 737 飞机的前排。该专用客舱配备更宽的两乘二布局躺椅、37 英寸至 38 英寸（94 厘米至 97 厘米）的座椅间距、热餐选择以及多小时航班上提供的免费酒精饮料。

Porter 在其顶级票价 PorterReserve 中采用了不同的硬件方法。 PorterReserve 没有安装更宽的商务舱座椅，而是采用了 E195-E2 客舱中相同的 2×2 座椅框架，但将前四排的座椅间距大幅扩大到 36 英寸（91 厘米）。 PorterReserve 不是一张更宽的椅子，而是一个完全捆绑、全包的票价等级，包括新鲜餐点、预调鸡尾酒、专门的机场办理登机手续、优先安检、提前登机、两件免费托运行李和免费航班改签。
在较短的国内航班中，PorterReserve 经常以传统商务舱成本的一小部分提供可比的腿部空间和卓越的软产品福利。然而，在超过四个小时的洲际航班上，寻求真正的宽体躺椅或平躺床的乘客会发现西捷航空的硬件更加舒适。

航空分析师和行业评论家经常将 PorterReserve 视为一种增强型、包罗万象的经济舱产品，而不是传统的商务舱。 Frugal Flyer 2026 年 9 月的一篇评论指出，尽管 PorterReserve 没有达到国际长途商务舱标准（以纸板包装和标准座椅填充物提供的冷餐为例），但其性价比直接挑战了加拿大航空的国内商务舱和西捷航空高端舱。评论家得出的结论是，波特最好被理解为一种升级的、无麻烦的经济舱飞行方式，无需意外的附加费用。
波特的客舱舒适度大众化战略赢得了业界的广泛赞誉。乘客们将波特评为 APEX 四星级主要航空公司，该航空公司还荣获《今日美国》读者选择奖最佳经济舱奖，并被 Skytrax 评为北美最佳支线航空公司。
与此同时，西捷航空继续捍卫其高端定位，扩大其在欧洲和亚洲的长途梦想飞机网络，运营从卡尔加里国际机场 (YYC) 到罗马菲乌米奇诺机场 (FCO) 的直达航线。据 AvioRadar 报道，西捷航空高管强调，他们的两层战略将国际宽体豪华飞机与高密度区域机队相结合，提供了全球商务旅客所需的全方位服务灵活性。

与 Flair Airlines 等低成本替代航空公司相比，波特航空和西捷航空的可靠性和服务水平完全不同。超低成本航空公司剥夺了所有乘客设施，只提供最基本的运输，而波特则在不收取旗舰航空公司溢价的情况下提升了基本的飞行体验。与此同时，西捷航空通过提供从超基础经济舱到宽体跨大陆商务套房的一系列产品来实现自己的软产品差异化。

body_en: Eurowings carries over 18 million passengers as Berlin network expands - Aviation24.be
Home Lufthansa Group Eurowings Eurowings carries over 18 million passengers as Berlin network expands

Eurowings carried more than 18 million passengers on 129,000 flights during the first nine months of 2026. Its third-quarter load factor rose to 88%, while the airline reported a customer Net Promoter Score of 46 and positive crew ratings from 85% of travellers.

Berlin is a focus of its winter 2026/27 expansion, with two additional aircraft, increased frequencies and new winter services to Bologna, Rome, Nice, Kuusamo and Lisbon. Eurowings will serve 38 destinations from Berlin Brandenburg Airport during the season.

From 1 December, its Premium BIZ Seat will be offered on all Dubai flights and selected services to London, Mallorca and Málaga. The Airbus A320neo cabin features eight premium seats across two rows in a 2–2 layout, with adjustable leg rests and additional space.

Lufthansa Group’s Point-to-Point segment, which includes Eurowings and its SunExpress investment, generated third-quarter adjusted operating profit of €214 million. However, its nine-month result remained a €38 million loss, reflecting higher fuel costs, taxes and fees.

2026 年前 9 个月，欧洲之翼航空运营 129,000 架次航班，运送了超过 1800 万名乘客。第三季度客座率升至 88%，该航空公司的客户净推荐值高达 46 分，85% 的旅客对机组人员给予积极评价。

title_en: Air Tahiti Nui Will Offer Free Starlink Wi-Fi On Its Boeing 787s As Of 2027
title_zh: 大溪地航空将于 2027 年起在其波音 787 上提供免费 Starlink Wi-Fi
summary: Air Tahiti Nui will install free Starlink Wi-Fi on its four Boeing 787-9s in 2027, replacing a Panasonic system with pricing that's currently pretty outrageous.
summary_zh: 大溪地航空将于 2027 年在其四架波音 787-9 上安装免费的 Starlink Wi-Fi，以目前相当便宜的价格取代松下系统
body_en: Air Tahiti Nui has just announced a massive upgrade to its inflight connectivity, as the airline will be rolling out free Starlink Wi-Fi across its (small) fleet in 2027.
Air Tahiti signs up for SpaceX’s Starlink Wi-Fi

Air Tahiti Nui has revealed that it plans to install Starlink Wi-Fi on its entire fleet, which consists of four Boeing 787-9s. The airline plans to offer this service for free to passengers in all travel classes.

Starlink will be introduced in 2027, though no timeline beyond that is known yet, so it could be early or late in the year. Presumably once installation starts, it’ll be completed very quickly — four planes could easily be fitted with Starlink in a single week.

Air Tahiti Nui operates some very long flights — including from Papeete (PPT) to Paris (CDG) via Los Angeles (LAX) so having fast and free connectivity is super valuable. While so many airlines market their Wi-Fi as being high speed, Starlink is the only product currently in service where you can consistently stream videos, etc.
Air Tahiti Nui’s Wi-Fi pricing is currently outrageous

Currently, Air Tahiti Nui’s Dreamliners are equipped with Panasonic Wi-Fi, which actually has relatively decent speeds. The catch is that Air Tahiti Nui chooses to have insanely high pricing based primarily on data usage, rather than just offering a full flight pass for a fixed amount.
Below is Air Tahiti Nui’s current pricing chart for Wi-Fi… could they make this any more complicated? $28 for 100 MB of data is absurd, and $98 for unlimited data is even more ridiculous.

This kind of pricing just strikes me as being so stupid. All you end up doing is frustrating passengers, and I also have to imagine this isn’t actually the system that maximizes usage. It’s weird to have a provider with speeds that are actually semi-usable (Panasonic is better than OnAir), and to then do this with it.

So anyway, Starlink will simply be a massive upgrade for Air Tahiti Nui in every way. Speaking of which, I’d sure love to return to French Polynesia at some point (and fly that all-business class Air Tahiti turboprop , while I’m at it).

In 2027, Air Tahiti Nui intends to install Starlink Wi-Fi on its fleet of four Dreamliners. It remains to be seen exactly when in 2027 it’ll happen, but this represents a huge upgrade to the passenger experience. The airline currently offers Panasonic Wi-Fi with awful data-based pricing (or an unlimited package that will run you close to $100).
What do you make of Air Tahiti Nui introducing Starlink?
body_zh: 大溪地航空刚刚宣布对其机上连接进行大规模升级，该航空公司将于 2027 年在其（小型）机队中推出免费的 Starlink Wi-Fi。
大溪地航空签约 SpaceX 的 Starlink Wi-Fi
大溪地航空透露，计划在其由四架波音 787-9 组成的整个机队中安装 Starlink Wi-Fi。该航空公司计划向所有舱位的乘客免费提供这项服务。
星链将于 2027 年推出，但目前尚不清楚更晚的时间表，因此可能会在今年年初或年底。据推测，一旦安装开始，它将很快完成——一周内可以轻松地为四架飞机安装星链。
大溪地航空运营一些超长航班，包括从帕皮提 (PPT) 经洛杉矶 (LAX) 飞往巴黎 (CDG)，因此拥有快速、免费的网络连接非常有价值。虽然许多航空公司都将其 Wi-Fi 宣传为高速，但 Starlink 是目前唯一可以让您持续流式传输视频等的产品。
大溪地航空的 Wi-Fi 价格目前高得离谱
目前，大溪地航空的梦想飞机配备了松下Wi-Fi，速度其实还算不错。问题在于，塔希提岛航空主要根据数据使用情况选择高得离谱的定价，而不是仅仅提供固定金额的完整航班通行证。
以下是大溪地航空目前的 Wi-Fi 定价表……他们能让这变得更复杂吗？ 100 MB 数据 28 美元是荒谬的，无限数据 98 美元更荒谬。
这种定价让我觉得太愚蠢了。你最终所做的只是让乘客感到沮丧，而且我还必须想象这实际上并不是一个最大化使用的系统。有一个速度实际上是半可用的提供商（松下比 OnAir 更好），然后用它来做这件事，这很奇怪。
所以无论如何，星链将是大溪地航空在各个方面的一次大规模升级。说到这里，我肯定很想在某个时候返回法属波利尼西亚（并在我在那里时乘坐大溪地航空的全商务舱涡轮螺旋桨飞机）。
2027 年，大溪地航空打算在其四架梦想飞机机队上​​安装 Starlink Wi-Fi。 2027 年具体何时发生还有待观察，但这代表着乘客体验的巨大升级。该航空公司目前提供松下 Wi-Fi，其基于数据的定价非常糟糕（或者无限套餐，价格接近 100 美元）。

British Airways and Mexican low-cost airline Viva have announced a codeshare agreement covering connections to 13 destinations across Mexico, including Guadalajara, Monterrey and Puerto Vallarta. Flights are available to book now for travel from 28 March 2027.

The partnership links Viva’s domestic services through Mexico City and Cancún with British Airways flights to London. Customers can book connecting itineraries under a BA flight code through ba.com on a single ticket. British Airways Club members will also be able to earn Avios and tier points.
The agreement expands access to Mexico for passengers travelling from the UK and Europe, while customers departing from Mexican cities can connect through London to British Airways’ wider network.
Viva operates 110 Airbus A320 and A321 aircraft, serving more than 60 destinations across Mexico, the United States, Colombia, Costa Rica and Cuba.

body_en: Lufthansa signs €1.025 billion deal for 44.9% stake in TAP Air Portugal - Aviation24.be

Lufthansa Group and the Portuguese government signed an agreement in Lisbon on 3 November for the acquisition of an initial 44.9% stake in TAP Air Portugal for €1.025 billion. Completion remains subject to regulatory approvals, notably from the European Commission.

The investment will be financed entirely from existing liquidity. Lufthansa could increase its holding to 49.9% by acquiring shares initially offered to employees. Including a contractual “ticking fee”, the total purchase price could reach €1.2 billion.

Lufthansa intends to preserve TAP’s Portuguese identity and develop Lisbon as a group hub, expanding connections to Brazil, Portuguese-speaking Africa and North America. The group estimates that adding TAP would increase its combined share of Europe–Latin America traffic from approximately 9% to 20%.

Lufthansa says a minority holding would enable most of the anticipated synergies, estimated at up to €450 million, while expressing support for eventual full privatisation. Growth plans also encompass Porto, the Azores, Madeira and the Algarve.

summary_zh: 随着世界各地的航空公司继续与高油价作斗争，航空运输量有所上升。
body_en: JetBlue Hikes Checked Bag Fees Again To $50, A 43% Increase In Just 2 Years

Jack comes to Simple Flying with a lifelong interest in all things aviation. He holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech, and is a certified private and remote pilot. Beyond these experiences, Jack previously worked for a corporate flight department where he gained first-hand experience in the world of business aviation. Currently, Jack works in the professional services industry and continues to build his flight hours outside of work.

JetBlue has raised checked baggage fees for the second time this year, increasing the minimum charge for a first checked bag on most North American and Caribbean routes from $39 to $50 each way. The new prices apply to tickets purchased on or after November 3, 2026. Compared with the $35 minimum in effect in May 2024, the latest adjustment represents an increase of approximately 43%. Passengers who wait until the airport, travel during peak periods, or check additional luggage will pay considerably more.

The increase affects more than basic economy customers. Travelers holding standard Main and Main Flex fares are also subject to the higher charges unless they qualify for complimentary baggage through an eligible fare, loyalty programs , or JetBlue credit card. The airline says the changes will help offset rising fuel and operating expenses while allowing it to keep advertised base fares competitive. The move could also prompt another round of baggage-fee increases across the US airline industry.
First Checked Bag Now Costs At Least $50 Each Way

For flights within the United States , Canada, Latin America, and the Caribbean, JetBlue’s first checked bag now costs $50 each way during off-peak periods when purchased online or through the app more than 24 hours before departure. The price rises to $55 during peak travel periods. Customers who add a bag within 24 hours of departure pay $60 off-peak or $70 during peak dates.

Additional luggage has become more expensive, too, as reported by Thrifty Traveler . A second checked bag costs $70 off-peak and $75 during peak periods when prepaid, increasing to $75 and $85, respectively, when purchased closer to departure. A third checked bag carries a $200 charge regardless of the travel date. On transatlantic flights to Europe, the first bag on the cheapest economy fares starts at $80, with late purchases reaching $100.

Booking timing can significantly affect the final bill. A passenger checking one bag for a peak-season round trip could pay $110 by prepaying, or $140 if the bag is purchased at the airport. Tickets purchased before November 3 remain subject to the previous fee schedule, so the increase does not retroactively affect existing bookings.

The latest adjustment continues a series of increases that have made checked luggage substantially more expensive on JetBlue. In May 2024, the minimum fee for a first checked bag on domestic, Canadian, Caribbean, and Latin American routes was $35. It rose to $39 in March 2026 before reaching $50 in November. The change from $35 to $50 represents a 42.9% increase over roughly two and a half years.

JetBlue also varies baggage prices according to demand, booking timing, and route type rather than applying one universal charge. Peak periods include much of the summer, from late May through early September, as well as major holiday travel dates. March is the only month in 2027 without a designated peak travel date, according to the published schedule. This pricing structure allows the airline to collect more when demand is strongest.

Several customer groups remain exempt. JetBlue Mint passengers receive checked baggage as part of their fare, while TrueBlue Mosaic members receive one or two complimentary bags depending on their status level. Eligible JetBlue Plus, Business, and Premier credit cardholders can also receive a free first checked bag for themselves and up to three companions when the card is used to book the flight.
Fuel Costs And Industry-Wide Pricing Pressure

JetBlue directly attributed the latest increase to rising fuel and operating costs. A spokesperson said the airline is adjusting baggage charges to help keep base fares competitive while giving customers the option to pay only for services they use. Higher fuel prices have placed additional pressure on airline operating costs. US carriers generally do not hedge fuel purchases to the same extent as some international competitors, leaving them more immediately exposed when market prices climb. Baggage fees offer one way to recover some of those expenses without increasing the headline fare displayed during flight searches.

JetBlue’s financial position adds another consideration. The airline reported a $257 million third-quarter loss, renewing questions about its ability to return to sustained profitability. It denied speculation about a possible bankruptcy last week. Ancillary charges can generate additional revenue without making the initial ticket price appear less competitive, particularly among customers comparing fares across multiple airlines.

JetBlue has previously been an early mover on baggage pricing. After its March 2026 increase, other major US carriers followed with their own adjustments within weeks. That history does not guarantee another industry-wide response, but it gives competitors an opportunity to raise fees without being first. For passengers, the latest change is another reminder that the advertised airfare represents only part of the cost of flying with checked luggage.

body_zh: 捷蓝航空再次将托运行李费用提高至 50 美元，短短 2 年内上涨 43%
杰克 (Jack) 带着对航空一切事物的终生兴趣加入了简单飞行 (Simple Flying)。他拥有佐治亚理工学院的航空航天工程学位，并且是一名经过认证的私人和远程飞行员。除了这些经验之外，杰克还曾在公司飞行部门工作过，在那里他获得了公务航空领域的第一手经验。目前，杰克在专业服务行业工作，并在工作之外继续增加飞行时间。
捷蓝航空今年第二次提高托运行李费用，将大多数北美和加勒比航线的第一件托运行李最低收费从单程 39 美元提高到 50 美元。新价格适用于 2026 年 11 月 3 日或之后购买的门票。与 2024 年 5 月生效的 35 美元最低票价相比，最新调整价格上涨了约 43%。等到机场、在高峰时段旅行或托运额外行李的乘客将支付相当多的费用。
此次涨价影响的不仅仅是基本经济舱客户。持有标准 Main 和 Main Flex 票价的旅客也需要支付更高的费用，除非他们有资格通过符合条件的票价、忠诚度计划或捷蓝信用卡获得免费行李。该航空公司表示，这些变化将有助于抵消不断上涨的燃油和运营费用，同时使其保持广告基本票价的竞争力。此举还可能引发美国航空业新一轮的行李费上涨。
现在首件托运行李单程费用至少为 50 美元
对于美国、加拿大、拉丁美洲和加勒比海地区境内的航班，捷蓝航空的第一件托运行李现在在非高峰时段每程 50 美元，只要在出发前 24 小时以上在网上或通过应用程序购买即可。在旅游高峰期，价格会上涨至 55 美元。在出发前 24 小时内添加行李的乘客，非高峰期需支付 60 美元，高峰期需支付 70 美元。
据 Thrifty Traveler 报道，额外的行李也变得更加昂贵。如果预付费，第二件托运行李的费用在非高峰时段为 70 美元，在高峰时段为 75 美元，如果在临近起飞时购买，则分别增加到 75 美元和 85 美元。无论旅行日期如何，第三件托运行李均需支付 200 美元的费用。在飞往欧洲的跨大西洋航班上，最便宜经济舱票价的首件行李起价为 80 美元，后期购买价格可达 100 美元。
预订时间会极大地影响最终账单。旺季往返托运一件行李的乘客可以预付 110 美元，如果在机场购买行李则需要支付 140 美元。 11 月 3 日之前购买的机票仍遵循之前的费用表，因此此次涨价不会追溯影响现有预订。
最新的调整延续了一系列的上涨，导致捷蓝航空的托运行李费用大幅上涨。 2024 年 5 月，国内、加拿大、加勒比和拉丁美洲航线的首件托运行李最低费用为 35 美元。 2026 年 3 月升至 39 美元，11 月升至 50 美元。从 35 美元到 50 美元的变化意味着在大约两年半的时间里增长了 42.9%。
捷蓝航空还根据需求、预订时间和航线类型改变行李价格，而不是实行统一收费。高峰期包括夏季的大部分时间，从五月底到九月初，以及主要的假期旅行日期。根据公布的时间表，3 月是 2027 年唯一没有指定出行高峰日期的月份。这种定价结构使航空公司能够在需求最强劲时收取更多费用。
一些客户群体仍然豁免。 JetBlue Mint 乘客可在票价中获得托运行李，而 TrueBlue Mosaic 会员则可根据其身份级别获得一件或两件免费行李。当使用该卡预订航班时，符合资格的捷蓝 Plus、商务卡和贵宾卡持卡人还可以为自己和最多三名同伴免费获得一件第一件托运行李。
燃料成本和全行业的定价压力
捷蓝航空将最新的增长直接归因于燃油和运营成本的上升。一位发言人表示，该航空公司正在调整行李收费，以帮助保持基本票价的竞争力，同时让客户可以选择只为他们使用的服务付费。燃油价格上涨给航空公司运营成本带来了额外压力。美国航空公司通常不会像一些国际竞争对手那样对燃油采购进行对冲，这使得它们在市场价格上涨时更容易面临风险。行李费是一种在不增加航班搜索期间显示的总体票价的情况下收回部分费用的方法。
捷蓝航空的财务状况又增加了另一个考虑因素。该航空公司公布第三季度亏损 2.57 亿美元，再次引发人们对其恢复持续盈利能力的质疑。该公司上周否认了有关可能破产的猜测。辅助收费可以产生额外的收入，同时又不会降低初始机票价格的竞争力，尤其是在比较多家航空公司的票价的客户中。
捷蓝航空此前一直是行李定价的先行者。 2026 年 3 月涨价后，美国其他主要航空公司在几周内也做出了自己的调整。这段历史并不能保证再次出现全行业的反应，但它给竞争对手提供了在不率先提高费用的情况下提高费用的机会。对于乘客来说，最新的变化再次提醒人们，广告中的机票价格仅代表托运行李飞行费用的一部分。

body_en: Lufthansa Group lifts quarterly profit as cargo and maintenance offset higher fuel costs - Aviation24.be

Lufthansa Group reported record third-quarter revenue of €12.2 billion in 2026, up 9% year-on-year, while adjusted operating profit rose 6% to €1.4 billion. Strong demand and cost controls offset an additional €543 million in fuel costs, although the adjusted operating margin slipped to 11.5%.

Brussels Airlines, SWISS and Austrian Airlines improved their quarterly results. However, combined network airline adjusted operating profit fell by €108 million to €853 million, with Lufthansa Airlines affected by higher fuel costs and approximately €65 million in strike-related costs. Group chief executive Carsten Spohr said the core airline’s financial turnaround must accelerate.

Cargo and maintenance provided substantial support: Lufthansa Cargo’s adjusted operating profit more than tripled to €162 million, while Lufthansa Technik increased its result by 54% to €200 million. The point-to-point airlines segment earned €214 million, up €16 million.

The group refined its full-year adjusted operating profit forecast to €1.7–2.0 billion, with its fuel bill expected to reach €9.3 billion. Fourth-quarter demand, fuel costs and cargo performance will determine the final outcome.

布鲁塞尔航空、瑞士航空和奥地利航空改善了季度业绩。然而，合并后的网络航空公司调整后营业利润下降了 1.08 亿欧元，至 8.53 亿欧元，汉莎航空受到燃油成本上涨和约 6500 万欧元罢工相关成本的影响。集团首席执行官卡斯滕·斯波尔表示，核心航空公司的财务扭亏为盈必须加速。

body_en: The One 737 Variant That Saved Boeing's Narrowbody Line

Daniel comes to Simple Flying with a business focused approach to the aviation world. Daniel enjoys analyzing strategy and how companies move against each other to gain a step ahead in the skies. Besides strategy, Daniel also has a passion for aircraft design and the history of aviation.

Today, the aircraft is known for being the second-best-selling commercial jetliner of all time, behind only the competing Airbus A320. In the late 1970s, however, the Boeing 737 was not the dominant narrowbody that everyone knows it to be today. That was the Boeing 727, a larger, three-engined aircraft used for medium-length flights around the world, similar in size to modern 737 variants. Back then, the 737 was Boeing's small narrowbody, essentially used like a large regional jet, while the 727 dominated the industry.

In the late 1970s, however, the 727's three-engined layout was increasingly becoming obsolete, as the plane burned too much fuel for its size and range. Boeing would respond by developing an all-new, twin-engined layout that essentially did everything the 727 did but better. At the same time, there was demand for an improved 737 after the success of the 737-200. As such, Boeing began studies on a new 737 variant in 1979, and in 1984, the company released the massively successful 737-300.

By 1979, the 737 line was essentially the 737-200 Advanced. Slightly stretched from the original 737-100, the 737-200 became a popular choice worldwide for regional routes, competing against the McDonnell Douglas DC-9 . The Advanced became the production standard in 1971, incorporating aerodynamic and technical improvements to improve payload and range. It was a massive success, but the 737 was also aging by the late 1970s, creating demand for an improved version.

The most noticeable difference with the 737-300 was its extended fuselage, increasing passenger capacity and lowering unit costs. The aircraft's wing was tweaked for better aerodynamics. Boeing swapped out the 1960s-era Pratt & Whitney JT8Ds for the new CFM56-3 high-bypass turbofan, and the plane received a new vertical stabilizer design, while the cabin and flight deck were modernized. As a whole, the 737-300 was a significantly more capable, more efficient, and more advanced version of the already popular 737.

The 737-300 proved to be a very successful aircraft, with Boeing receiving hundreds of orders for the type after its entry into service in 1984. At this point, the aircraft was competing mainly against the McDonnell Douglas MD-80 , but it was more fuel-efficient while carrying slightly fewer passengers, and it was used by many airlines to replace older 727s as well. In the 1980s, the market also lined up well for the 737-300 to become a core part of Boeing's narrowbody offering alongside the 757.

By the late 1970s, both of Boeing's two narrowbody products were popular, but aging. The 737 was revitalized as the 737-300, while the airframer decided on a clean-sheet twinjet to succeed the 727. The 757 carried more passengers and payload than the 727, while having superior takeoff performance, a longer range, and better fuel burn. It was an appealing aircraft for airlines wanting an aircraft larger than the 737, and it also proved effective in replacing 707s and DC-8s on transcontinental flights in the US, given its range.

However, the 757 wasn't as desirable as Boeing may have hoped when it debuted in 1983 . The US market began shifting towards smaller aircraft, and the 757 seated more passengers than the 727. Fuel prices also dropped, and the 757 was an expensive aircraft to buy.

Many airlines chose to simply keep their depreciated 727s longer, while others bought the cheaper MD-80, which also entered service earlier than the 757. The 737-300 became a crucial aircraft, as it occupied this space of being more fuel-efficient than prior jetliners, while also being smaller and cheaper to buy than the 757. It became a popular replacement for the 727 as a result.

Orders for the 757 picked up in the late 1980s , and the aircraft went on to be a successful program. However, it was during this time with the 737-300 that the aircraft started transitioning towards becoming the core of Boeing's narrowbody lineup, whereas it was the 727 that dominated sales in the past. This shift only became more apparent as Boeing was able to further iterate on the design by releasing an even larger variant as well as a smaller version that could directly succeed the 737-200.

While the 737-300 was stretched by about three seat rows over the 737-200, the 757 could seat an additional 60 or 70 passengers compared to the 737-300. This left a major hole in Boeing's narrowbody lineup, especially as the MD-80 was larger than the 737-300. With strong demand from airlines for a larger 737, Boeing stretched the airframe by about three to four rows, creating the 737-400. Debuting in 1988 with Piedmont Airlines, the 737-400 also proved to be an attractive aircraft like its older sibling.

What makes a stretch aircraft like the 737-400 attractive is its low per-seat costs, since the plane burns almost the same fuel as the 737-300 while offering significantly more seats. However, not all airlines need an aircraft that can seat as many as 188 passengers, and even the 737-300 was larger than the first-generation 737. As such, Boeing shrank the fuselage to create the 737-500, which entered service in 1990 to directly succeed the 737-200. Not only was the aircraft smaller, but it had the best range and takeoff performance of any 737 variant.

On its own, the 737-300's sales might not look all that impressive, as Boeing sold 1,113 examples. However, the 737-300 transformed the 737 into a family, with the 737-400 and 737-500 variants each offering something different to appeal to a wider range of customers. The 737-400 received 486 orders, while the 737-500 received 389 orders, bringing the 737 Classic up to 1,988 sales in total. In contrast, the 757 (including the later 757-300) received 1,049 orders, while the competing MD-80 received 1,191 orders.

European newcomer Airbus had made a name for itself in the 1970s with its A300, a medium-sized twinjet widebody that outsold both of its rivals (the McDonnell Douglas DC-10 and Lockheed L-1011 TriStar). It also later developed the A310 as a smaller derivative with better range, to more limited success. After years of design studies, it officially launched the clean-sheet single-aisle A320 in 1984. body_zh: 拯救波音窄体飞机生产线的 One 737 改型
Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。
如今，该飞机被誉为有史以来第二畅销的商用喷气式客机，仅次于竞争对手空客 A320。然而，在 20 世纪 70 年代末，波音 737 并不是今天众所周知的占主导地位的窄体飞机。那就是波音 727，这是一款较大的三引擎飞机，用于全球中型飞行，其尺寸与现代 737 型号相似。当时，737 是波音的小型窄体飞机，基本上像大型支线飞机一样使用，而 727 则主导了该行业。

然而，在 20 世纪 70 年代末，727 的三引擎布局逐渐过时，因为相对于其尺寸和航程而言，该飞机燃烧的燃油过多。波音公司对此做出了回应，开发了一种全新的双引擎布局，该布局基本上完成了 727 所做的一切，而且做得更好。与此同时，在 737-200 获得成功后，出现了对改进型 737 的需求。因此，波音公司于 1979 年开始研究新的 737 改型，并于 1984 年发布了获得巨大成功的 737-300。
到 1979 年，737 系列基本上是 737-200 Advanced。 737-200 在最初的 737-100 的基础上略有延伸，成为全球支线航线的热门选择，与麦道 DC-9 竞争。 Advanced 于 1971 年成为生产标准，融合了空气动力学和技术改进，以提高有效载荷和航程。它取得了巨大成功，但 737 到 20 世纪 70 年代末也开始老化，产生了对改进版本的需求。
与 737-300 最显着的区别是机身加长，增加了载客量并降低了单位成本。飞机的机翼经过调整以获得更好的空气动力学性能。波音公司将 1960 年代的普惠 JT8D 飞机替换为新型 CFM56-3 高涵道比涡扇发动机，飞机采用了新的垂直安定面设计，同时对机舱和飞行甲板进行了现代化改造。总体而言，737-300 是已经流行的 737 的一个功能更强大、更高效、更先进的版本。
737-300 被证明是一款非常成功的飞机，自 1984 年投入使用以来，波音公司收到了数百架该型号的订单。此时，该飞机主要与麦道 MD-80 竞争，但它的燃油效率更高，但载客量略少，并且许多航空公司也用它来取代旧的 727。 20 世纪 80 年代，市场也让 737-300 与 757 一起成为波音窄体飞机的核心组成部分。

到 20 世纪 70 年代末，波音公司的两款窄体机产品都很受欢迎，但都已经老化。 737 被重新命名为 737-300，而机身制造商决定采用全新的双发喷气式飞机来接替 727。757 比 727 运载更多乘客和有效载荷，同时具有卓越的起飞性能、更远的航程和更好的燃油消耗。对于想要一架比 737 更大的飞机的航空公司来说，这是一款很有吸引力的飞机，而且考虑到其航程，它也被证明可以有效取代美国跨大陆航班上的 707 和 DC-8。
然而，757 并没有像波音 1983 年首次亮相时所希望的那样受欢迎。美国市场开始转向小型飞机，757 的载客量比 727 多。燃油价格也下降，757 是一架昂贵的飞机。
许多航空公司选择延长其折旧的 727 飞机，而另一些航空公司则购买更便宜的 MD-80，该飞机也比 757 更早投入使用。737-300 成为一款至关重要的飞机，因为它占据了比以前的喷气式客机更省油的空间，同时也比 757 更小、更便宜。因此，它成为 727 的热门替代品。
757 的订单在 20 世纪 80 年代末开始增加，该飞机项目后来取得了成功。然而，正是在这段时间，737-300 飞机开始转变为波音窄体机系列的核心，而过去主导销售的是 727。随着波音能够通过发布更大的变体以及可以直接继承 737-200 的较小版本来进一步迭代设计，这种转变变得更加明显。

虽然 737-300 比 737-200 增加了约三排座位，但与 737-300 相比，757 可以多容纳 60 或 70 名乘客。这给波音的窄体飞机阵容留下了一个重大漏洞，特别是 MD-80 比 737-300 更大。由于航空公司对更大的 737 的强烈需求，波音将机身拉伸了约三到四排，创造了 737-400。 737-400 于 1988 年随皮埃蒙特航空公司 (Piedmont Airlines) 首次亮相，也被证明是一款与其老机型一样具有吸引力的飞机。

像 737-400 这样的加长飞机之所以有吸引力，是因为它的每座成本较低，因为该飞机燃烧的燃油几乎与 737-300 相同，同时提供了更多的座位。然而，并非所有航空公司都需要一架最多可容纳 188 名乘客的飞机，甚至 737-300 也比第一代 737 更大。因此，波音缩小了机身，打造了 737-500，该机型于 1990 年投入使用，直接接替 737-200。该飞机不仅体积更小，而且在所有 737 改型中具有最佳的航程和起飞性能。

就其本身而言，737-300 的销量可能看起来并不那么令人印象深刻，因为波音共售出了 1,113 架。然而，737-300 将 737 转变为一个系列，其中 737-400 和 737-500 型号各提供不同的功能，以吸引更广泛的客户。 737-400 收到 486 架订单，737-500 收到 389 架订单，使 737 Classic 的总销量达到 1,988 架。相比之下，757（包括后来的 757-300）收到了 1,049 份订单，而竞争对手 MD-80 则收到了 1,191 份订单。

欧洲新秀空中客车公司在 20 世纪 70 年代凭借 A300 名声大噪，这是一款中型双发宽体飞机，销量超过了其两个竞争对手（麦道 DC-10 和洛克希德 L-1011 TriStar）。后来，该公司还开发了 A310 作为更小、航程更远的衍生机型，但取得的成功却有限。经过多年的设计研究，它于 1984 年正式推出了全新的单通道 A320。但要真正取得成功，空中客车公司不能仅仅制造出一架与美国人制造的飞机一样好的飞机；还必须制造出与美国制造的飞机一样好的飞机。它需要做出一个更好的。

body_en: Brussels Airlines achieves record third-quarter result with €84 million adjusted EBIT - Aviation24.be
Belgian carrier benefits from increased capacity and stable operations, while geopolitical uncertainty and high fuel costs continue to weigh on its outlook.

Brussels Airlines has reported its strongest-ever third-quarter financial performance, achieving an adjusted EBIT of €84 million in the period from July to September 2026. The record result was driven primarily by increased capacity, passenger growth and more reliable operations.

During the third quarter, the Belgian airline welcomed 2.9 million passengers on more than 20,000 flights, representing year-on-year increases of 3.5% in passenger numbers and 1.7% in flight operations.

Operational stability played a key role in the improved financial performance. Brussels Airlines reduced its irregularity costs per passenger by 14% compared with the same period last year. Combined with increased capacity, this contributed to an adjusted EBIT that was 23.5% higher than in the third quarter of 2025 and 6% above the previous third-quarter record, set in 2024.

“ For an airline, summer is the busiest time of year. While many people travel to enjoy a well-deserved vacation, our colleagues put their best foot forward to make sure our passengers can sit back and relax. I want to sincerely thank all Brussels Airlines employees for their efforts in the past few months. We have once again proven that when we operate as planned, the results are also there. Brussels Airlines is a robust airline that can deliver strong results, even in a challenging environment ,” said Nina Öwerdieck, Chief Financial Officer of Brussels Airlines.
Beyond its financial performance, Brussels Airlines also recorded several commercial and product highlights during the quarter.

The airline continued its traditional Tomorrowland party flights, while Cologne in Germany was added to its network through its cooperation with Deutsche Bahn. Brussels Airlines also introduced a new signature aperitif in Business Class as part of its ongoing efforts to enhance the passenger experience.
Despite the record third-quarter performance, Brussels Airlines remains cautious about the months ahead.

The first half of 2026 proved challenging for the airline. Geopolitical instability contributed to elevated fuel prices, while an Ebola outbreak in East Africa and social unrest in Belgium, including strikes involving third parties, further affected operations and financial performance. As a result, the airline recorded a negative financial result for the first six months of the year.
The strong third-quarter performance has since brought Brussels Airlines back into positive year-to-date territory. Nevertheless, several external challenges remain unresolved.

The start of the fourth quarter has already brought further disruption, with an external strike resulting in flight cancellations and additional costs for the airline. Despite these setbacks, passenger demand remains robust, providing a positive signal for the remainder of the year.
Brussels Airlines expects business to develop positively in the fourth quarter, although the ongoing impact of geopolitical uncertainty and higher fuel costs continues to require careful management.
Cost discipline alongside strategic investments

To counter the continued pressure from additional fuel costs, Brussels Airlines is maintaining its cost-optimisation measures. At the same time, the airline remains committed to strategic investments aimed at improving its onboard product and overall passenger experience.
Planned initiatives include the rollout of Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi across the fleet, a complete renovation of the airline’s flagship lounge in Brussels and the introduction of new cabin interiors.

With a record-breaking third quarter behind it, Brussels Airlines enters the final months of 2026 on a stronger financial footing. However, the airline’s ability to maintain this momentum will depend on operational stability, cost developments and the wider geopolitical environment.

body_zh: 布鲁塞尔航空公司第三季度业绩创历史新高，调整后息税前利润为 8400 万欧元 - Aviation24.be
比利时航空公司受益于运力的增加和运营的稳定，而地缘政治的不确定性和高燃油成本继续影响其前景。
布鲁塞尔航空公司公布了有史以来最强劲的第三季度财务业绩，2026 年 7 月至 9 月期间调整后的息税前利润达到 8400 万欧元。这一创纪录的业绩主要是由于运力增加、乘客增长和更可靠的运营推动的。
第三季度，比利时航空公司共执行 20,000 多个航班，接待旅客 290 万人次，旅客数量同比增长 3.5%，航班运营量同比增长 1.7%。
运营稳定性对于财务业绩的改善发挥了关键作用。与去年同期相比，布鲁塞尔航空公司将每位乘客的不正常费用降低了 14%。再加上产能的增加，调整后的息税前利润比 2025 年第三季度高出 23.5%，比 2024 年创下的上一第三季度纪录高出 6%。
“对于航空公司来说，夏季是一年中最繁忙的时期。虽然许多人旅行是为了享受当之无愧的假期，但我们的同事竭尽全力确保我们的乘客能够高枕无忧。我要衷心感谢所有布鲁塞尔航空员工在过去几个月中所做的努力。我们再次证明，只要按计划运营，成果就一定会实现。布鲁塞尔航空是一家实力雄厚的航空公司，即使在充满挑战的环境下也能取得强劲业绩。”布鲁塞尔航空首席财务官 Nina Öwerdieck 说道航空公司。
除了财务业绩外，布鲁塞尔航空公司在本季度还记录了多项商业和产品亮点。
该航空公司继续其传统的Tomorrowland派对航班，同时通过与德国铁路的合作将德国科隆纳入其网络。布鲁塞尔航空公司还在商务舱推出了一款新的招牌开胃酒，作为其持续努力增强乘客体验的一部分。
尽管第三季度业绩创下历史新高，布鲁塞尔航空公司对未来几个月仍持谨慎态度。
事实证明，2026 年上半年对该航空公司来说充满挑战。地缘政治不稳定导致燃油价格上涨，而东非埃博拉疫情和比利时社会动荡（包括第三方罢工）进一步影响了运营和财务业绩。结果，该航空公司今年前六个月的财务业绩为负。
此后，第三季度的强劲表现使布鲁塞尔航空公司重回年初至今的正值。然而，一些外部挑战仍未解决。
第四季度初已经带来了进一步的干扰，外部罢工导致航班取消并给航空公司带来了额外成本。尽管遇到这些挫折，乘客需求仍然强劲，为今年剩余时间提供了积极信号。
布鲁塞尔航空公司预计第四季度业务将积极发展，尽管地缘政治不确定性和燃油成本上涨的持续影响仍然需要谨慎管理。
成本纪律与战略投资
为了应对额外燃油成本带来的持续压力，布鲁塞尔航空公司正在维持其成本优化措施。与此同时，该航空公司仍然致力于战略投资，旨在改善其机上产品和整体乘客体验。
计划的举措包括在整个机队中推出汉莎航空集团 Wi-Fi、对布鲁塞尔的航空公司旗舰休息室进行彻底翻新以及采用新的客舱内饰。
凭借破纪录的第三季度业绩，布鲁塞尔航空以更强劲的财务基础进入 2026 年最后几个月。然而，该航空公司保持这一势头的能力将取决于运营稳定性、成本发展和更广泛的地缘政治环境。

summary: A major route reshuffle has seen the carriers rearrange its Toronto to Mumbai links as fleets and stopovers shift and schedules realign.
summary_zh: 随着机队和中途停留地的变化以及时刻表的重新调整，航空公司重新安排了多伦多至孟买的航线。
body_en: Air Canada Cancels All Flights To This Long-Haul Destination: See Map Now

Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

Air Canada will not resume its service from Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ) to Mumbai Airport (BOM) next year, as the airline restructures its Indian operations. The Star Alliance carrier has historically maintained the service to Mumbai with a stop en route at London Heathrow Airport (LHR).

Data from Cirium , an aviation analytics company, shows that the service to Mumbai has been operated with a mix of both the airline's Boeing 787-8 and 787-9 aircraft. It was last served in March 2026.

The service cancellation comes as Air Canada opts out, while Air India will step in . The Indian flag carrier will serve the route instead, with Air Canada deploying its aircraft elsewhere. Air Canada's service to Mumbai, as previously mentioned, operated as a one-stop service via London, providing an extension to the airline's existing robust network of flights through the British capital.

Flights from Toronto operated to London, and then, as a fifth-freedom service , onward to Mumbai. They departed from Toronto in the evening for an overnight service to London, before departing from the UK at midday for an early morning arrival into Mumbai the following morning.

Return flights departed from Mumbai at the eye-watering time of 4:00 AM (standard for India to Europe departures), with a mid-morning arrival into London. Onward flights to Toronto departed after lunch, for a later afternoon arrival back in Toronto. The full schedule for the service is detailed in the table above.
Credit: Renato Oliveira de Araujo | Shutterstock

As Air Canada terminates its Mumbai service, the route will be picked up by Air India, which will operate the service with a stopover in Rome Fiumicino Airport (FCO) on the India to Canada leg. Return flights are expected to operate nonstop.

This will see Air Canada's Indian destinations drop to just one, Delhi Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL). The Star Alliance carrier operates to Delhi with nonstop flights from Toronto year-round, while seasonal flights are added from Montréal-Trudeau International Airport (YUL).

As these schedule changes come into effect, Air Canada is also planning its service resumption to Tel Aviv (TLV) and Dubai International Airport (DXB) this coming March, subject to the ongoing geopolitical tension in the Middle East. A snapshot of the airline's Middle East plans for later this year, and the beginning of 2027, can be seen in the table above.

Air Canada maintains flights to India due to strong family, cultural, and trade ties between the two countries. There is a large Indian diaspora in Canada, and there are an estimated 800,000 people with Indian heritage who reside in the Greater Toronto area, according to the website Indians In Canada . Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is also set to visit Toronto in December.

Strong trade ties fuel a large part of the airline's demand to serve India, and with ongoing restrictions on Russian airspace access , this has forced the airline to reroute service, such as through London Heathrow for its Mumbai link. Air Canada has had a long history of serving India, having served the country on and off again for many decades. Its latest modern nonstop service began in 2015, when the airline began its service from Toronto to Delhi.

记者 – Aaron 是一名航空和旅行记者，在旅行和旅游业拥有 14 年的经验。他的背景涵盖机场运营、航空基础设施和旅游咨询，曾与新西兰、欧洲和北美的全球组织合作。
Aaron 将行业专业知识与五大洲超过 52 个国家/地区的第一手旅行经验相结合，涵盖航空公司、机场、航空政策和更广泛的旅行领域。他居住在新西兰坎特伯雷。
他的作品发表在《Simple Flying》上，并受到 MSN、SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel、EIN News、Pakistan Defence 和 Climate Depot 的专题报道。
由于加拿大航空重组其印度业务，明年将不会恢复从多伦多皮尔逊国际机场 (YYZ) 飞往孟买机场 (BOM) 的航班。这家星空联盟航空公司历来维持飞往孟买的航班，途中经停伦敦希思罗机场 (LHR)。
航空分析公司 Cirium 的数据显示，飞往孟买的航班由该航空公司的波音 787-8 和 787-9 飞机混合运营。上次服务时间为 2026 年 3 月。
此次服务取消之际，加拿大航空选择退出，而印度航空将介入。印度旗舰航空公司将改为执飞这条航线，而加拿大航空则将其飞机部署在其他地方。如前所述，加拿大航空飞往孟买的航班是经伦敦的一站式服务，为该航空公司现有的经过英国首都的强大航班网络提供了延伸。
从多伦多出发飞往伦敦的航班，然后作为第五条自由航线，继续飞往孟买。他们晚上从多伦多出发，隔夜飞往伦敦，然后中午从英国出发，第二天一早抵达孟买。
返程航班于令人瞠目结舌的凌晨 4:00（印度飞往欧洲航班的标准时间）从孟买起飞，并于上午中旬抵达伦敦。午餐后飞往多伦多的续程航班起飞，下午晚些时候返回多伦多。上表详细列出了该服务的完整时间表。
图片来源：Renato Oliveira de Araujo | Shutterstock
由于加拿大航空终止其孟买服务，该航线将由印度航空执飞，该航线将在印度至加拿大航线的罗马菲乌米奇诺机场 (FCO) 中途停留。预计返程航班将直达。
这将使加拿大航空的印度目的地减少到只有一个：德里英迪拉甘地国际机场 (DEL)。这家星空联盟航空公司全年有从多伦多飞往德里的直飞航班，同时还增加了从蒙特利尔特鲁多国际机场 (YUL) 出发的季节性航班。
随着这些时刻表变更生效，加拿大航空还计划在今年 3 月恢复飞往特拉维夫 (TLV) 和迪拜国际机场 (DXB) 的航班，以应对中东地区持续紧张的地缘政治局势。上表显示了该航空公司今年晚些时候和 2027 年初的中东计划。
由于两国之间牢固的家庭、文化和贸易联系，加拿大航空保留了飞往印度的航班。据加拿大印第安人网站称，加拿大有大量印度裔侨民，估计居住在大多伦多地区的印度裔有 80 万。印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪也定于 12 月访问多伦多。
牢固的贸易关系推动了该航空公司为印度提供服务的很大一部分需求，而由于俄罗斯领空的持续限制，这迫使该航空公司改变服务航线，例如通过伦敦希思罗机场飞往孟买。加拿大航空拥有为印度提供服务的悠久历史，数十年来断断续续地为该国提供服务。其最新的现代直达服务始于 2015 年，当时该航空公司开始提供从多伦多飞往德里的服务。

title_en: US Army Black Hawk Helicopter Nearly Struck By Fireworks During Dramatic NFL Flyover
title_zh: 美国陆军黑鹰直升机在 NFL 飞越戏剧性表演时差点被烟花击中
summary: A US Army Black Hawk narrowly avoided fireworks during an NFL flyover in Seattle, raising questions about stadium pyrotechnics and aviation safety
summary_zh: 一架美国陆军黑鹰在西雅图 NFL 飞越期间险些避开烟花，引发了对体育场烟火和航空安全的质疑
body_en: US Army Black Hawk Helicopter Nearly Struck By Fireworks During Dramatic NFL Flyover

Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

A US Army Black Hawk helicopter narrowly avoided a potentially dangerous encounter with stadium fireworks during a pregame flyover at an NFL game between the Seattle Seahawks and Chicago Bears on November 2, 2026. The incident occurred at Lumen Field in Seattle, Washington, when pyrotechnics erupted while the final helicopter in a four-aircraft formation was still passing over the stadium. Dramatic footage captured the fireworks exploding remarkably close to the military aircraft, prompting audible gasps from spectators.

The flyover was part of the national anthem ceremony ahead of the Monday Night Football matchup, which attracted approximately 70,000 spectators. Although military helicopter appearances are a familiar feature of major sporting events in the United States, the incident raised questions about coordination between stadium personnel and military flight crews. Fortunately, the helicopter continued flying after the fireworks erupted, with no apparent damage reported.
Fireworks Explode Dangerously Close To The Final Black Hawk In Formation

Four US Army Sikorsky UH-60M Black Hawk helicopters from the 2-158th Assault Helicopter Battalion, part of the 16th Combat Aviation Brigade, performed the ceremonial flyover at Lumen Field. The aircraft approached the stadium in formation as part of the pregame celebrations before the Seahawks faced the Chicago Bears. According to MyNorthwest , the first three helicopters passed over the stadium before the fireworks display began. However, the fourth aircraft was still nearby when the stadium's pyrotechnics were activated.

Video footage shared widely on social media shows fireworks launching from the stadium structure and exploding extremely close to the trailing helicopter. From certain camera angles, the pyrotechnics appear to pass alongside the aircraft's rear section, creating the impression that the helicopter might have been struck. The aircraft nevertheless continued its flight behind the other three helicopters, with no visible signs of damage.

The incident was also reported by the New York Post , which highlighted the frightening proximity of the fireworks and the reactions from spectators. While some footage appears to show fireworks passing directly alongside the aircraft, it remains unclear whether any projectile actually made contact. Neither an official explanation for the timing nor confirmation of an aircraft inspection was available in the initial reporting.
Why Fireworks Can Pose A Serious Threat To Helicopters And Aircraft

Fireworks are generally not compatible with aircraft operating in close proximity, especially during low-altitude helicopter demonstrations. Although a military helicopter such as the UH-60M is designed for demanding operating environments, its rotors, engines, flight controls, and other components remain vulnerable to foreign objects and external damage. A firework exploding near a helicopter could potentially expose its crew to burning debris, heat, and fragments, while also creating a distraction during a maneuver that requires precise aircraft control.

Sikorsky, part of Lockheed Martin, manufactures the Black Hawk , a twin-engine military utility helicopter. Its design emphasizes operational versatility, survivability, and the ability to continue flying under challenging conditions. However, these characteristics should not be mistaken for immunity to airborne hazards. Even a relatively small incident involving a rotor blade or an engine intake could have serious consequences, particularly when an aircraft is operating close to a crowded venue.

A historical example also shows why coordination between aircraft operators and pyrotechnics teams is essential. On July 23, 1982, a Bell UH-1 helicopter crashed in California during the filming of Twilight Zone: The Movie after special-effects explosions detonated too close to the aircraft. The accident killed actor Vic Morrow and two child actors, and injured six other people. According to the National Transportation Safety Board's investigation , debris and heat from the explosions damaged the helicopter's rotor blades, causing the tail rotor assembly to separate and the helicopter to descend uncontrollably. The investigation identified inadequate communication and coordination between the helicopter pilot and film director as contributing factors.
How Airshows Safely Combine Military Aircraft And Pyrotechnic Displays

Despite the potential dangers, aircraft demonstrations and pyrotechnics can be combined in the same organized event when appropriate safety procedures are in place. Airshows regularly combine military aircraft demonstrations, ground-based explosions, smoke effects, and other theatrical elements to recreate combat scenarios or enhance performances, and we have personally witnessed many such impressive performances, including the legendary one at Oshkosh . The key distinction is that these activities require careful planning, clearly defined operating areas, and communication between participating teams. Aircraft must follow predetermined flight paths that keep them away from designated pyrotechnic zones.

The Federal Aviation Administration ( FAA ) provides specific guidance for organizing aviation events involving ground-based pyrotechnics. Its airshow safety requirements emphasize documenting pyrotechnic device locations, establishing appropriate public-protection procedures, and coordinating ground operations. The agency also highlights the importance of separating aircraft movements from fireworks displays. Its guidance on mass aircraft demonstrations further stresses the need for detailed flight plans, mandatory briefings, and geographical, vertical, lateral, and time separation between participating aircraft.

For stadium flyovers, timing is everything because helicopters generally fly slower than many fixed-wing aircraft, so they can stay near a venue longer. This makes coordination between flight crews, stadium production teams, and pyrotechnics operators especially important. In Seattle, the fireworks appeared to begin before the final Black Hawk had completely cleared the stadium area. Although the helicopter continued flying without any apparent consequences, the incident demonstrated how a seemingly routine pregame celebration can create an unnecessary aviation hazard.
body_zh: 美国陆军黑鹰直升机在 NFL 飞越戏剧性表演时差点被烟花击中
经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。
2026 年 11 月 2 日，在西雅图海鹰队和芝加哥熊队之间的 NFL 比赛中，一架美国陆军黑鹰直升机在赛前飞越时险些与体育场烟花发生潜在危险。事件发生在华盛顿州西雅图的流明球场，当时烟火爆发，而四机编队中的最后一架直升机仍在体育场上空飞过。戏剧性的镜头捕捉到烟花在军用飞机附近爆炸，引起观众的喘息声。
该天桥是周一晚上足球比赛之前国歌仪式的一部分，吸引了大约 70,000 名观众。尽管军用直升机亮相是美国重大体育赛事的常见特征，但这一事件引发了人们对体育场工作人员和军事机组人员之间协调的质疑。幸运的是，烟花爆发后，直升机继续飞行，没有造成明显损坏。
烟花在接近最后黑鹰队形的地方危险地爆炸
第 16 战斗航空旅第 2-158 突击直升机营的四架西科斯基 UH-60M 黑鹰直升机在流明机场进行了飞行仪式。作为海鹰队对阵芝加哥熊队之前赛前庆祝活动的一部分，这架飞机列队接近体育场。据 MyNorthwest 报道，烟花表演开始前，前三架直升机飞越了体育场上空。然而，当体育场的烟火被激活时，第四架飞机仍在附近。
社交媒体上广泛传播的视频片段显示，烟花从体育场结构中发射，并在距离尾随直升机非常近的地方爆炸。从某些摄像机角度来看，烟火似乎沿着飞机后部经过，给人一种直升机可能被击中的印象。尽管如此，这架飞机仍继续在其他三架直升机后面飞行，没有明显的损坏迹象。
《纽约邮报》也报道了这一事件，强调了烟花的可怕距离和观众的反应。虽然一些镜头似乎显示烟花直接从飞机旁边经过，但目前尚不清楚是否有任何射弹真正发生接触。最初的报告中既没有对飞机检查的时间进行官方解释，也没有对飞机检查进行确认。
为什么烟花会对直升机和飞机构成严重威胁
烟花通常不适合近距离飞行的飞机，特别是在低空直升机表演期间。尽管 UH-60M 等军用直升机是为苛刻的操作环境而设计的，但其旋翼、发动机、飞行控制装置和其他部件仍然容易受到异物和外部损坏。在直升机附近爆炸的烟花可能会使机组人员暴露在燃烧的碎片、热量和碎片中，同时也会在需要精确控制飞机的机动过程中造成干扰。
西科斯基隶属于洛克希德·马丁公司，生产黑鹰，这是一种双引擎军用通用直升机。其设计强调操作多功能性、生存能力以及在挑战性条件下继续飞行的能力。然而，这些特性不应被误认为对空气传播的危害具有免疫力。即使涉及转子叶片或发动机进气口的相对较小的事故也可能造成严重后果，特别是当飞机在拥挤的场地附近运行时。

一个历史例子也说明了为什么飞机操作员和烟火团队之间的协调至关重要。 1982 年 7 月 23 日，一架贝尔 UH-1 直升机在拍摄《暮光之城：电影》期间在加利福尼亚州坠毁，原因是特效爆炸离飞机太近。事故导致演员维克·莫罗和两名儿童演员死亡，另有六人受伤。根据美国国家运输安全委员会的调查，爆炸产生的碎片和热量损坏了直升机的旋翼桨叶，导致尾桨组件分离，直升机失控下降。调查发现，直升机飞行员和电影导演之间沟通和协调不足是造成这一情况的因素。
航展如何安全地将军用飞机和烟火表演结合起来
尽管存在潜在危险，但在适当的安全程序到位的情况下，飞机演示和烟火表演可以合并在同一个有组织的活动中。航展经常结合军用飞机演示、地面爆炸、烟雾效果和其他戏剧元素来重现战斗场景或增强表演效果，我们亲眼目睹了许多这样令人印象深刻的表演，包括奥什科什的传奇表演。关键区别在于这些活动需要仔细规划、明确定义的操作区域以及参与团队之间的沟通。飞机必须遵循预定的飞行路线，远离指定的烟火区域。
美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 为组织涉及地面烟火的航空活动提供了具体指导。其航展安全要求强调记录烟火装置位置、建立适当的公共保护程序以及协调地面操作。该机构还强调了将飞机起降与烟花表演分开的重要性。它对大规模飞机演示的指导进一步强调了详细的飞行计划、强制性简报以及参与飞机之间的地理、垂直、横向和时间间隔的必要性。
对于体育场天桥而言，时机至关重要，因为直升机通常比许多固定翼飞机飞行得慢，因此它们可以在场馆附近停留更长时间。这使得机组人员、体育场制作团队和烟火操作人员之间的协调尤为重要。在西雅图，烟花似乎在最后一场黑鹰完全清空体育场区域之前就开始了。尽管直升机继续飞行，没有造成任何明显后果，但这一事件表明，看似例行公事的赛前庆祝活动可能会造成不必要的航空危险。

body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

JetBlue continues to change as the carrier confronts many ongoing challenges. As part of this, and influenced by the exit of the now-defunct Spirit Airlines, it has really focused on growing at Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL). Significantly, JetBlue now has more flights from the Florida airport than it does from New York JFK or Boston .

The airline's network has seen many changes recently. For example, so far this year, JetBlue has ceased 13 international routes . All are to the Caribbean, Mexico, or Central America, although there are big questions about whether another European route will end .

The following list does not include New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) to Ponce, in Puerto Rico, as that country is a US territory and the route was domestic. Flights ended in January this year after being served for 21 years. As JFK remains JetBlue's leading international gateway, particularly for short-haul operations, nearly half of the eliminated markets (six) are from the Big Apple's busiest airport.
JFK to Bonaire ( Bonaire fully removed from network )
JFK to Tulum ( Tulum fully removed from network )
JFK to Belize City ( Belize City fully removed from network )
JFK to Antigua ( Antigua fully removed from network )

Perhaps unsurprisingly, most of the links only launched fairly recently. Nine were inaugurated between 2020 and 2025, including all but one from JFK and all but one from Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR). JetBlue grew significantly at EWR during the COVID-19 pandemic. Freed-up aircraft enabled the carrier to test out things that it might not have ever done.

Cirium Diio data shows that JetBlue had an average of 44 daily departures from EWR in 2021 (domestic and international), which has fallen to about 15 for 2026. Total international activity from the New Jersey airport has fallen by 90% in the same period. Only one international route remains (Santiago, in the Dominican Republic). The airline has moved away from EWR to where it believes it can win.
JetBlue's San Pedro Sula Flights Did Not Last Long

Once renowned as the world's most dangerous city, with 20+ murders a day, San Pedro Sula is located not far from the northern coast of Honduras. It is the second most populous city in the Central American nation.

The US Department of State recommends passengers 'reconsider travel' to Honduras due to the overall rate of crime, gang activity, and violence. Of course, most passengers are Honduran Americans or the Honduran diaspora. When all airlines are included, booking data suggests that more than 1.6 million people flew between the US and Honduras in the 12 months to May 2026 (4,300+ daily).

JetBlue's debuted in Honduras in June 2025, initially with only one route: JFK to San Pedro Sula's Ramón Villeda Morales International Airport (SAP). The carrier flew daily on the A320, with an overnight flight back to the Big Apple. It was, at the time, one of two airlines on the airport pair, coexisting with Avianca, but that carrier pulled out in January 2026. United Airlines continues to operate between EWR and SAP.

JetBlue served JFK-SAP between June 2025 and May 2026. The US Department of Transportation shows that the airline carried 70,070 round-trip passengers, but only filled 68.1% of the available seats. Only four months had a load factor that exceeded 70.0%. While fare and yield information is unavailable, it is no wonder the route was cut. JetBlue still operates between FLL and SAP.
body_zh: 詹姆斯与路线开发息息相关。詹姆斯曾就读于拉夫堡大学和克兰菲尔德大学航空运输管理专业，拥有航空公司战略和经济学博士学位。 James 曾任伦敦卢顿机场市场机会分析师和 anna.aero 首席分析师。他向本科生和研究生教授航空公司战略和经济学五年，并与多家航空公司在航线和市场情报项目上密切合作。他居住在英国伦敦附近。
随着捷蓝航空面临许多持续的挑战，捷蓝航空不断发生变化。作为其中的一部分，并受到现已解散的精神航空退出的影响，它真正专注于在劳德代尔堡好莱坞国际机场 (FLL) 的发展。值得注意的是，捷蓝航空现在从佛罗里达机场起飞的航班比从纽约肯尼迪机场或波士顿起飞的航班还要多。
该航空公司的网络最近发生了许多变化。例如，今年到目前为止，捷蓝航空已经停止了13条国际航线。全部航线都是加勒比海、墨西哥或中美洲，尽管另一条欧洲航线是否会结束还存在很大疑问。
以下列表不包括纽约约翰·肯尼迪国际机场 (JFK) 至波多黎各庞塞的航班，因为该国是美国领土，且航线为国内航线。航班在运营 21 年后于今年 1 月结束。由于肯尼迪机场仍然是捷蓝航空的主要国际门户，尤其是短途航班，因此近一半的被淘汰市场（六个）来自纽约最繁忙的机场。
肯尼迪机场飞往博内尔岛（博内尔岛已完全从网络中删除）

也许并不奇怪，大多数链接最近才推出。 9 架飞机于 2020 年至 2025 年间启用，其中除肯尼迪机场外，其余所有飞机均来自肯尼迪机场，除纽瓦克自由国际机场 (EWR) 外，其余所有飞机均来自纽瓦克自由国际机场 (EWR)。在 COVID-19 大流行期间，捷蓝航空在 EWR 的业务显着增长。释放的飞机使航母能够测试它可能从未做过的事情。

Cirium Diio 数据显示，2021 年，捷蓝航空平均每天有 44 班从 EWR 出发的航班（国内和国际），到 2026 年已降至 15 班左右。同期，新泽西机场的国际航班总量下降了 90%。仅剩一条国际航线（多米尼加共和国的圣地亚哥）。该航空公司已从 EWR 转向它认为能够获胜的领域。
捷蓝航空的圣佩德罗苏拉航班并没有持续多久
圣佩德罗苏拉位于洪都拉斯北部海岸不远，曾经被誉为世界上最危险的城市，每天发生 20 多起谋杀案。它是中美洲国家人口第二多的城市。
由于犯罪、帮派活动和暴力的总体发生率，美国国务院建议乘客“重新考虑”前往洪都拉斯的旅行。当然，大多数乘客是洪都拉斯美国人或洪都拉斯侨民。如果包括所有航空公司，预订数据显示，截至 2026 年 5 月的 12 个月内，有超过 160 万人次在美国和洪都拉斯之间飞行（每天 4,300 多人次）。
捷蓝航空于 2025 年 6 月在洪都拉斯首次亮相，最初只有一条航线：肯尼迪机场飞往圣佩德罗苏拉的拉蒙·维莱达·莫拉莱斯国际机场 (SAP)。该航空公司每天都使用 A320 执飞，并提供夜间航班返回纽约。当时，它是这两个机场中的两家航空公司之一，与阿维安卡航空公司共存，但该航空公司于 2026 年 1 月退出。联合航空公司继续在 EWR 和 SAP 之间运营。
捷蓝航空于 2025 年 6 月至 2026 年 5 月期间为肯尼迪-SAP 提供服务。美国交通部显示，该航空公司运送了 70,070 名往返乘客，但只占据了 68.1% 的可用座位。仅四个月客座率超过70.0%。虽然无法获得票价和收益信息，但这条路线被削减也就不足为奇了。捷蓝航空仍在 FLL 和 SAP 之间运营。

title_en: JetBlue Leads The Industry In Raising Checked Bag Fees… Again!
title_zh: 捷蓝航空再次引领行业提高托运行李费用！
summary: JetBlue has raised checked bag fees for the second time this year, with a first bag on domestic flights now costing $50-70. Expect competitors to follow.
summary_zh: 捷蓝航空今年第二次提高托运行李费用，目前国内航班的第一件行李收费为 50 至 70 美元。预计竞争对手会效仿
body_en: For whatever reason, JetBlue tends to be the industry leader when it comes to raising checked bag fees, and competitors tend to follow. Earlier this year, JetBlue was the first major US carrier to raise checked bag fees , and now the airline is raising checked bag fees again…
JetBlue tries to boost revenue with higher checked bag fees

Effective immediately (for tickets purchased as of November 3, 2026), JetBlue has increased checked bag fees . JetBlue has a rather complicated fee structure for checked bags, with both off-peak and peak pricing, plus different pricing based on whether you pay for the bag 24 hours or more in advance.
Below is a chart with JetBlue’s new checked bag fees.

As you can see, an off-peak first checked bag on a domestic flight will now cost you $50-60 (depending on whether you pay in advance), while a peak first checked bag on a domestic flight will now cost you $55-70 (depending on whether you pay in advance). For context, below are the dates that are considered peak for the purposes of bag fees.

It goes without saying that paying $50-70 for a first checked bag is a pretty substantial cost, especially when you consider how little checked bags used to cost. On a one-way, you’re looking at $100-140. For a family of four, you’d be looking at $400-560.
Raising checked bag fees is easy money for airlines

When JetBlue raised checked bag fees earlier this year, the airline released a statement claiming it was increasing checked bag fees to be “more competitive,” and that “while we recognize that fee increases are never ideal, we take careful consideration to ensure these changes are implemented only when necessary.” I imagine this time around, the logic is much of the same.

The simple reality is that oil prices are way up. Airlines have actually done a solid job of being able to make fare increases stick. But that’s not enough to fully offset the increase in the cost of jet fuel.

JetBlue is in a rough financial spot, and it hasn’t turned a profit since before the pandemic. The airline is hoping to turn an operating profit in 2027 , though that strikes me as being particularly optimistic. So the logic for raising checked bags is threefold
The airline expects competitors to match, so when every airline is charging more, it doesn’t become a reason to book away from JetBlue
JetBlue hopes that raising checked bag fees will drive more people to apply for a co-branded JetBlue credit card, which obviously has a lot of financial upside for the carrier
A lot of consumers might be put off by a higher fare, but might not notice very high checked bag fees, since it’s not necessarily the first thing someone checks

JetBlue has just increased checked bag fees once again, and you’ll now pay $50-70 for a first checked bag on a domestic flight. This is JetBlue’s second price increase on checked bags so far this year. When airlines are trying to increase revenue, checked bag fees are often low hanging fruit.

When competitors match, it also becomes something that’s unavoidable for consumers, other than getting a credit card… which also has upside for the airline! I’d be shocked if other airlines don’t match this move from JetBlue.
What do you make of JetBlue increasing checked bag fees?
body_zh: 无论出于何种原因，捷蓝航空在提高托运行李费用方面往往处于行业领先地位，而竞争对手也往往紧随其后。今年早些时候，捷蓝航空是美国第一家提高托运行李费的主要航空公司，现在该航空公司再次提高托运行李费……
捷蓝航空试图通过提高托运行李费来增加收入
捷蓝航空提高了托运行李费用，立即生效（对于 2026 年 11 月 3 日之后购买的机票）。捷蓝航空的托运行李费用结构相当复杂，既有非高峰期定价，也有高峰期定价，而且根据您是否提前 24 小时或更长时间支付行李费用，定价也有所不同。
下面是捷蓝航空新的托运行李费用图表。
如您所见，国内航班的非高峰期首件托运行李现在的费用为 50-60 美元（取决于您是否提前付款），而国内航班的高峰期首件托运行李现在的费用为 55-70 美元（取决于您是否提前付款）。作为背景信息，以下是行李费被视为高峰的日期。
不用说，为第一件托运行李支付 50-70 美元是一笔相当可观的费用，尤其是当您考虑到过去托运行李的费用是多么少时。单程票价为 100-140 美元。对于一个四口之家来说，你的价格是 400-560 美元。
提高托运行李费对航空公司来说很容易赚钱
当捷蓝航空今年早些时候提高托运行李费时，该航空公司发表了一份声明，声称提高托运行李费是为了“更具竞争力”，并且“虽然我们认识到费用上涨从来都不是理想的情况，但我们会仔细考虑，以确保仅在必要时实施这些变化。”我想这一次的逻辑大致相同。
简单的现实是石油价格大幅上涨。事实上，航空公司在维持票价上涨方面做得非常扎实。但这还不足以完全抵消航空燃油成本的增加。
捷蓝航空的财务状况很糟糕，自疫情爆发前以来一直没有实现盈利。该航空公司希望在 2027 年实现营业利润，尽管这让我觉得特别乐观。因此，提出托运行李的逻辑有三重
该航空公司希望竞争对手能够与之匹配，因此当每家航空公司都收取更高费用时，这并不能成为从捷蓝航空预订机票的理由
捷蓝航空希望提高托运行李费能够带动更多人申请捷蓝联名信用卡，这显然对捷蓝航空有很大的财务优势
许多消费者可能会因较高的票价而望而却步，但可能不会注意到非常高的托运行李费，因为这不一定是有人检查的第一件事
捷蓝航空刚刚再次提高了托运行李费用，现在国内航班的第一件托运行李费用为 50 至 70 美元。这是捷蓝航空今年以来第二次提高托运行李价格。当航空公司试图增加收入时，托运行李费往往是容易实现的目标。
当竞争对手匹配时，这也成为消费者除了获得信用卡之外不可避免的事情……这对航空公司来说也有好处！如果其他航空公司不效仿捷蓝航空的这一举措，我会感到震惊。
您如何看待捷蓝航空提高托运行李费？

title_en: Air India eyes more widebody jets as new CEO predicts return to profitability
title_zh: 新任首席执行官预测印度航空将恢复盈利，计划推出更多宽体客机
summary: Air India is considering additional widebody aircraft orders from Boeing and Airbus as its new CEO, Tewolde Gebremariam,… The post Air India eyes more widebody jets as new CEO predicts return to profitability appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 印度航空正在考虑从波音和空中客车公司获得更多宽体飞机订单，其新任首席执行官 Tewolde Gebremariam ......
body_en: Air India is considering additional widebody aircraft orders from Boeing and Airbus as its new CEO, Tewolde Gebremariam, sets in motion plans to expand international operations and return the airline to profitability.
Speaking at the Aviation India and South Asia Summit in New Delhi on November 3, 2026, Gebremariam said the airline wants to grow its long-haul fleet and expects to become profitable “very soon.”
“We want more wide-body aircraft,” Gebremariam said, confirming that Air India has been discussing additional orders with both manufacturers.
He declined to say how many aircraft the airline might purchase.

The potential orders would add to Air India’s existing commitments for 600 aircraft from Boeing and Airbus, including 80 widebodies. Those orders comprise 50 Airbus A350s, 20 Boeing 787 Dreamliners and 10 Boeing 777Xs.
About 10 of the 80 widebody aircraft have been delivered. Air India currently operates a fleet of 61 widebody aircraft.

The CEO said the airline is seeking to regain international market share from foreign competitors while attracting more passengers connecting between international destinations through its Indian hubs.
“Air India has been punching below its weight and that will change,” Gebremariam said.

The airline is also reviewing its international network as Pakistan’s airspace restrictions continue to complicate long-haul operations, particularly flights departing Delhi for Europe and North America.
Gebremariam said Air India is considering moving more of those services to Mumbai, where flights are less affected by the restrictions.
The airline is also evaluating Bengaluru as a third major hub alongside Delhi and Mumbai.
Air India’s expansion plans come as the carrier works to reduce operating costs and improve its financial performance.

Air India and subsidiary Air India Express reported a combined net loss of approximately 222.4 billion rupees ($2.5 billion) for the financial year ending March 2026, more than double the previous year’s loss.
Gebremariam identified high operating costs as a major concern and said the airline is working to bring its costs closer to industry averages.
He also said he was more impatient to achieve profitability than Air India’s shareholders, Tata Group and Singapore Airlines, which are taking a longer-term approach to the airline’s development.

The airline has been undergoing a multibillion-dollar transformation since returning to Tata Group ownership in January 2022. The program includes new aircraft, upgraded cabins, an expanded international network and improvements to customer service.
Tata Group owns approximately 75% of Air India, with Singapore Airlines holding the remaining 25%.
Gebremariam took over as CEO in October 2026, succeeding Campbell Wilson, who led the airline through the initial stages of its transformation following privatization.

The new CEO previously spent more than a decade leading Ethiopian Airlines , overseeing the carrier’s expansion into Africa’s largest airline and developing Addis Ababa into a major international connecting hub.

body_zh: 印度航空正在考虑从波音和空中客车公司获得额外的宽体飞机订单，其新任首席执行官 Tewolde Gebremariam 启动了扩大国际业务并使该航空公司恢复盈利的计划。
格布雷马里亚姆于 2026 年 11 月 3 日在新德里举行的印度航空和南亚峰会上发表讲话时表示，该航空公司希望扩大其长途机队，并预计“很快”实现盈利。
“我们想要更多的宽体飞机，”格布雷马里亚姆说，他确认印度航空一直在与两家制造商讨论额外订单。
他拒绝透露该航空公司可能购买多少架飞机。
这些潜在订单将增加印度航空现有的订购 600 架波音和空客飞机的承诺，其中包括 80 架宽体飞机。这些订单包括 50 架空客 A350、20 架波音 787 梦想飞机和 10 架波音 777X。
80 架宽体飞机中约有 10 架已交付。印度航空目前运营着一支由 61 架宽体飞机组成的机队。
这位首席执行官表示，该航空公司正在寻求从外国竞争对手手中夺回国际市场份额，同时吸引更多通过其印度枢纽在国际目的地之间转机的乘客。
格布雷马里亚姆表示：“印度航空的表现一直低于其自身实力，这种情况将会改变。”
由于巴基斯坦的空域限制继续使长途运营变得复杂，特别是从德里出发飞往欧洲和北美的航班，该航空公司还在审查其国际网络。
格布雷马里亚姆表示，印度航空正在考虑将更多服务转移到孟买，因为那里的航班受限制的影响较小。
该航空公司还将班加罗尔评估为继德里和孟买之后的第三个主要枢纽。
印度航空推出扩张计划之际，该公司正在努力降低运营成本并改善财务业绩。
印度航空及其子公司印度航空快运公司报告称，截至 2026 年 3 月的财年净亏损总计约 2224 亿卢比（25 亿美元），是上一年亏损的两倍多。
格布雷马里亚姆认为高运营成本是一个主要问题，并表示该航空公司正在努力使其成本接近行业平均水平。
他还表示，他比印度航空的股东塔塔集团和新加坡航空更急于实现盈利，后者正在为该航空公司的发展采取长期策略。
自 2022 年 1 月回归塔塔集团所有权以来，该航空公司一直在经历数十亿美元的转型。该计划包括新飞机、升级客舱、扩大国际网络和改善客户服务。
塔塔集团拥有印度航空约75%的股份，新加坡航空持有剩余25%的股份。
Gebremariam 于 2026 年 10 月接替坎贝尔·威尔逊 (Campbell Wilson) 出任首席执行官，后者领导该航空公司经历了私有化后转型的初始阶段。
这位新任首席执行官此前曾领导埃塞俄比亚航空公司十多年，监督该航空公司扩张为非洲最大的航空公司，并将亚的斯亚贝巴发展成为主要的国际转机枢纽。
印度航空新任首席执行官预计将恢复盈利，并计划推出更多宽体客机，这一消息首先出现在 AeroTime 网站上。
